metadata.title: Muskmelon & Pork | Northeastern recipe
metadata.description:
Meat cooked with fruits is a rather uncommon food combination. Out here in Northeastern India, there are few fruits which are cooked with meat be it pork, beef, chicken or even fish.
People prefer to cook with papaya, pineapple and even muskmelon. The fruits impart a very good aroma and flavour to the dish and the result is delicious.-
